apple.name: apple
apple.soil_type: Deep, loamy, well-aerated soil rich in humus (pH 5.5 - 6.5)
apple.fertilizer_guide: High Potassium and Phosphorus; requires adequate Calcium to prevent bitter pit.
apple.economic_value: Premium cash crop in temperate hill regions with long cold-storage viability.
apple.description: Temperate deciduous fruit requiring 1,000-1,500 chilling hours below 7°C to break winter dormancy.

banana.name: banana
banana.soil_type: Rich, deep, loose loamy soil with high organic matter (pH 6.5 - 7.5)
banana.water_requirement: Very High (1800 - 2500 mm or regular drip irrigation every 3-4 days)
banana.fertilizer_guide: Heavy potassium and nitrogen feeder (200g N, 60g P, 300g K per plant).
banana.economic_value: Highest return per acre among quick fruit crops with continuous harvest cycles.
banana.description: Fast-growing giant herbaceous perennial requiring tropical heat, heavy moisture, and substantial nutrient supply.

blackgram.name: blackgram
blackgram.soil_type: Heavier soils, loamy or clay loam with high organic content
blackgram.fertilizer_guide: Starter Nitrogen (20 kg/ha), Phosphorus (40 kg/ha), Sulfur supplementation.
blackgram.economic_value: Essential for culinary batters (dosa, idli, dal makhani); consistently high market rate.
blackgram.description: Nutrient-dense legume rich in phosphoric acid. Tolerates warm humid climates and enhances soil organic nitrogen.

chickpea.name: chickpea
chickpea.soil_type: Deep loamy or clay loam with good drainage (pH 6.0 - 8.0)
chickpea.fertilizer_guide: Low Nitrogen (fixes atmospheric N), high Phosphorus (40-60 kg P2O5/ha).
chickpea.economic_value: Premium protein source with excellent export and domestic wholesale value.
chickpea.description: Chickpea is a major winter pulse crop. Natural nitrogen-fixing ability enriches soil fertility for rotation crops.

coconut.name: coconut
coconut.soil_type: Coastal sandy, alluvial, or red sandy loam with good depth
coconut.growth_duration: Perennial (economic yield starts year 5-7, lasts 60+ years)
coconut.water_requirement: High (1500 - 2500 mm rainfall or continuous subsoil coastal moisture)
coconut.fertilizer_guide: High Potassium (K) and Chlorine (500g N, 320g P, 1200g K per palm/year).
coconut.economic_value: 'Kalpavriksha' (Tree of Life); every part produces income (water, copra, oil, coir).
coconut.description: The quintessential tropical palm thriving along coastal belts and humid lowlands with abundant sun and moisture.

coffee.name: coffee
coffee.season: Perennial Hill Crop (Blossom showers in March; Harvest: Nov-Feb)
coffee.soil_type: Deep, porous, well-drained volcanic or forest loam rich in organic humus (pH 6.0 - 6.5)
coffee.water_requirement: High to Moderate (1500 - 2000 mm with distinct dry winter period before blossom)
coffee.fertilizer_guide: Balanced NPK (120:90:120 kg/ha) with trace elements, shade tree organic mulch.
coffee.economic_value: Top global traded beverage commodity with high international market premium.
coffee.description: Shade-grown tropical highland shrub cultivated on misty hill slopes. Requires filtered sunlight and cool hill air.

cotton.name: cotton
cotton.soil_type: Deep black cotton soils (regur) or fertile loams with high clay retention
cotton.water_requirement: Moderate (700-1100 mm; dry weather essential during boll opening)
cotton.fertilizer_guide: NPK (100:50:50 kg/ha); magnesium and boron prevent leaf reddening and boll drop.
cotton.economic_value: Foremost natural textile fiber worldwide; critical export commodity.
cotton.description: Major commercial fiber crop requiring warm climate, at least 180-200 frost-free days, and sunny boll-maturing season.

grapes.name: grapes
grapes.soil_type: Sandy loam, gravelly well-drained soils with no hard pan
grapes.water_requirement: Moderate (Precise drip management; dry sunny weather during harvest)
grapes.fertilizer_guide: Very high Potassium (K) requirement for sugar translocation and bunch quality.
grapes.economic_value: Commercial powerhouse for table consumption, raisins, juice, and viticulture.
grapes.description: Vine crop thriving in semi-arid sunny conditions with low humidity during berry ripening to prevent fungal mildew.

jute.name: jute
jute.soil_type: New alluvial soils deposited by annual river flooding (pH 6.0 - 7.5)
jute.water_requirement: Very High (Thrives in monsoon floodplains; standing water tolerated late stage)
jute.fertilizer_guide: High Nitrogen (60-80 kg N/ha) for rapid vegetative stem elongation; 30 kg P, 30 kg K.
jute.economic_value: Eco-friendly biodegradable packaging, burlap, geotextiles, and specialty paper.
jute.description: The world's leading golden fiber crop, flourishing in the Bengal and Brahmaputra river basins with monsoon heat and humidity.

kidneybeans.name: kidneybeans
kidneybeans.soil_type: Light, loose, well-aerated sandy loam with pH 5.5 - 6.5
kidneybeans.fertilizer_guide: Requires higher initial Nitrogen as nodulation is relatively poor compared to other pulses.
kidneybeans.economic_value: High market retail value; popular delicacy with long storage life.
kidneybeans.description: Kidney beans require cool to moderate climate and rich, well-draining soil. Highly sensitive to frost and waterlogging.

lentil.name: lentil
lentil.soil_type: Alluvial, light loams, clay soils with moderate drainage
lentil.water_requirement: Low (Grown primarily as rainfed or with 1-2 irrigations)
lentil.fertilizer_guide: 20 kg N, 40 kg P2O5, 20 kg K2O per hectare.
lentil.economic_value: Global pulse commodity; stable consumer demand and low input cost.
lentil.description: Cool-season legume with delicate foliage. Highly efficient in low-moisture winter conditions.

maize.name: maize
maize.soil_type: Well-drained deep loamy soil rich in organic matter
maize.fertilizer_guide: Balanced NPK (120:60:40 kg/ha); sensitive to zinc deficiency.
maize.economic_value: High demand for food, livestock feed, biofuel, and starch industries.
maize.description: Maize is a versatile cereal crop requiring warm sunshine and well-aerated soil. Cannot tolerate waterlogging.

mango.name: mango
mango.soil_type: Deep, well-drained alluvial, red, or lateritic loam (pH 5.5 - 7.5)
mango.water_requirement: Moderate (Stress required before flowering; regular irrigation during fruit set)
mango.fertilizer_guide: Graduated NPK dosage per tree age; micro-nutrients (Boron, Zinc) prevent fruit drop.
mango.economic_value: 'King of Fruits' with exceptional domestic demand and lucrative international export.
mango.description: Tropical fruit with extensive lifespan. Requires distinct dry spell in winter to stimulate blossom induction.

mothbeans.name: mothbeans
mothbeans.soil_type: Sandy, sandy-loam, even low fertility soils
mothbeans.water_requirement: Very Low (One of the most drought-hardy legumes in existence)
mothbeans.fertilizer_guide: Minimal fertilizer needed; 10 kg N, 20 kg P2O5 per hectare.
mothbeans.economic_value: Valuable drought-resilience food and nutritious dryland fodder.
mothbeans.description: Extremely drought-resistant crop suited for arid zones. Excellent ground cover that prevents wind erosion.

mungbean.name: mungbean
mungbean.soil_type: Well-drained fertile loam to sandy loam (pH 6.2 - 7.2)
mungbean.water_requirement: Low to Moderate (Sensitive to excess water and overcast weather)
mungbean.fertilizer_guide: 15-20 kg N and 40 kg P2O5; benefits greatly from phosphorus fertilization.
mungbean.economic_value: Short duration cash turnaround; high nutrition and sprout demand.
mungbean.description: Rapid-growth legume ideal for crop rotation between main cereal seasons. Matures in barely two months.

muskmelon.name: muskmelon
muskmelon.soil_type: Fertile sandy loam with good drainage and pH 6.0 - 7.0
muskmelon.water_requirement: Moderate (Irrigate furrow or drip; keep vines dry to prevent mildew)
muskmelon.fertilizer_guide: NPK (60:40:40 kg/ha); potassium enhances aromatics and netting quality.
muskmelon.economic_value: High demand in domestic fruit markets during scorching summer periods.
muskmelon.description: Thrives in dry, hot summer conditions. High sunshine and low humidity during ripening create maximum sweetness and aroma.

orange.name: orange
orange.soil_type: Well-drained light loamy or sandy loam (pH 6.0 - 7.5, zero waterlogging)
orange.water_requirement: Moderate (Regular scheduled drip; sensitive to salinity and stagnant water)
orange.fertilizer_guide: Balanced citrus nutrition (600g N, 200g P2O5, 400g K2O/plant); Micronutrients: Zn, Fe, Mn.
orange.economic_value: Perennial cash crop with strong beverage, processing, and fresh fruit value.
orange.description: Subtropical citrus tree demanding sunny climate, well-aerated root zone, and moderate humidity.

papaya.name: papaya
papaya.season: Year-round in warm tropical & frost-free zones
papaya.soil_type: Rich, well-drained alluvial or loam soil with high humus content
papaya.growth_duration: 9 - 12 months to first harvest; productive for 2-3 years
papaya.water_requirement: High to Moderate (Highly vulnerable to collar rot if flooded)
papaya.fertilizer_guide: Heavy feeder: 200g N, 200g P, 250g K per plant applied in 6 bi-monthly splits.
papaya.economic_value: Fast capital return; high consumer demand for fresh consumption and papain enzyme.
papaya.description: Fast-growing tropical tree-like herb producing fruit within a year. Extremely sensitive to frost and water accumulation.

pigeonpeas.name: pigeonpeas
pigeonpeas.soil_type: Deep well-drained loam or alluvial soil (pH 6.5 - 7.5)
pigeonpeas.water_requirement: Moderate to Low (Deep tap root allows deep moisture mining)
pigeonpeas.fertilizer_guide: 20-25 kg N, 50 kg P2O5 per hectare; Rhizobium seed inoculation recommended.
pigeonpeas.economic_value: Core daily protein pulse across South Asia; commanding resilient pricing.
pigeonpeas.description: Pigeon pea is an essential perennial-grown-as-annual pulse. Deep roots aerate soil and break up subsoil compaction.

pomegranate.name: pomegranate
pomegranate.soil_type: Deep well-drained sandy loam or alluvial soil (tolerates slight salinity)
pomegranate.water_requirement: Moderate (Drip irrigation recommended; dry weather needed during ripening)
pomegranate.fertilizer_guide: High Potassium during fruit development; balanced N-P-K (600:200:200 g/plant/year).
pomegranate.economic_value: High-value export fruit; strong domestic antioxidant beverage and fresh fruit market.
pomegranate.description: Subtropical fruit renowned for drought tolerance and high antioxidant arils. Prefers semi-arid climates with warm summers.

rice.name: rice
rice.soil_type: Clayey, alluvial soil with high water retention
rice.water_requirement: High (Standing water 5-10 cm during vegetative phase)
rice.fertilizer_guide: High Nitrogen (Split application: basal, tillering, panicle), moderate P & K.
rice.economic_value: Primary staple food crop; high domestic demand and stable market price.
rice.description: Rice is the primary dietary staple for over half the world's population. It thrives in high humidity, prolonged rainfall, and warm temperatures.

watermelon.name: watermelon
watermelon.soil_type: Sandy, sandy loam, warm riverbed soils with rapid drainage
watermelon.water_requirement: Moderate (High early on; reduce watering near harvest to sweeten brix)
watermelon.fertilizer_guide: Balanced NPK (80:50:50 kg/ha); avoid excess late Nitrogen which softens rinds.
watermelon.economic_value: High quick-turn profit crop during peak hot summer months.
watermelon.description: Warm-season vine requiring long sunny days and warm soil. Sensitive to cold temperatures and stagnant water.
